home.presidentP1: Welcome to the website of the Kazek University Institute of Technology and Management, a special place nestled in the seaside city of Limbe. At Kazek you will have the opportunity to study alongside world-class professors and at the same time enjoy the fabulous natural position of the city, situated between the rainforest-swathed foothills of Mt Cameroon and the dramatic Atlantic coastline. Whether you are pursuing a certificate, Diploma, Bachelor or Master degree, we invite you to be part of our distinctive community.
home.presidentP2: We invite you to take a look around our new website to get to know about Kazek University. As you explore our website you will discover that we believe in developing you for lifelong learning and a career that is purpose-driven and meaningful. You will find a wealth of information about our programs, certifications, student services, facilities and activities.
home.presidentP3: We invite you to visit our campus and meet us in person. We welcome the chance to share with you how becoming a member of the Kazek learning community can help you prepare for all your future endeavors.

admissions.title: How to Apply to Kazek University
admissions.intro: Applications are made online through the Kazek portal. Follow the steps below.
admissions.closed: Applications are currently closed. Contact the admissions office for the next intake.
admissions.step1Body: Sign up on the Kazek portal with your email address. You will use it to follow your application.
admissions.step2Body: Pick up to three programmes in order of preference, your entry route (straight or top-up) and your study option.
admissions.step3Body: Birth certificate, national ID card and your certificates or transcripts, as listed below.
admissions.step4Body: The admissions office reviews your file. You can follow its status in your account and download your offer letter.
admissions.step5Body: Accept the offer online to receive your matricule and student login, then pay your registration fee.
admissions.straightBody: Birth certificate, national ID card, GCE Ordinary Level and GCE Advanced Level certificates (or their equivalents).
admissions.topupBody: Birth certificate, national ID card and your HND transcript.
admissions.portalCta: Already a student or staff member? Log in to the portal
